authoritative_source.operative_clause: For integer n and real r, r<=n iff ceiling(r)<=n; ceiling(r) is the least integer at least r. The new local proof derives this order fact from existing A-page floor/discreteness bodies and supplies the positive-size clamp.

mathematical_checks.ceiling: k=floor(-x) gives c=-k with c-1<x<=c. If integer m>=x were <c, positive integer c-m>=1 would force m<=c-1<x, contradiction.
mathematical_checks.positive_size: For a>=0, c=ceiling(a)>=0 is integer; max(1,c) is a positive natural at least a. Any positive integer n>=a is at least both1 andc, proving leastness. Integer fixed points give ceiling0=0 and ceiling4=4.
